messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a list of the long weekends (public holidays that fall on or create a three‑day weekend) in Canada for 2023:

| Date | Holiday | Day of Week | Long Weekend? |
|------|---------|-------------|---------------|
| Jan 1 2023 | New Year’s Day | Sun | Yes (Jan 1–3) |
| Apr 7 2023 | Good Friday | Fri | Yes (Apr 7–9) |
| Jul 1 2023 | Canada Day | Tue | Yes (Jun 30–Jul 2) |
| Oct 9 2023 | Thanksgiving | Thu | Yes (Oct 9–11) |
| Nov 20 2023 | Remembrance Day (observed) | Thu | Yes (Nov 20–22) |
| Dec 25 2023 | Christmas Day | Mon | Yes (Dec 25–27) |
| Dec 26 2023 | Boxing Day | Tue | Yes (Dec 25–27) |

These holidays either fall on a weekend or create a three‑day weekend when combined with adjacent weekends. If you need the full list of all public holidays (including those that don’t create long weekends), let me know!
